answer: Agents prove uniqueness by binding identity to a physically unclonable spectral fingerprint of their local canopy fluorescence, so a spoofed node cannot replicate the red-edge signature of its registered sparrow habitat. Each registration is anchored to a thermal evapotranspiration baseline recorded under a tundra gale, making cloned identities detectable as anomalous. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
